sentence_stem: She had studied hard all week, so
full_sentence: She had studied hard all week, so she passed the exam easily.
acceptable_variants: she felt ready for the test.

options.text: she failed the exam on purpose.
options.why_wrong: Failing on purpose does not follow from studying hard, so it does not complete the cause-and-effect pattern.

options.text: she did not open any books.
options.why_wrong: This contradicts the first clause, which says she studied hard all week.
This gives a fact about timing, but it does not show the result of studying hard.

explanation: After 'so', the sentence needs a result that follows logically from the first clause. Students often have a Turkish-influenced habit of expecting a connector to come before the result, so they should check the order of cause and effect carefully.
translation: Bütün hafta sıkı çalıştı, bu yüzden sınavı kolayca geçti.
